strongest_angle: Examining the formal letter sent by Ethiopian Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos to the United Nations Security Council accusing Eritrea of an all-out invasion in Tigray.

key_facts.fact: Ethiopia accused Eritrea of an all-out invasion of its northern Tigray region in an official letter to the United Nations Security Council.
Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos stated that the military incursion by Eritrea is a blatant act of aggression engaging Ethiopia's right to self-defense.
Ethiopian military vehicles and troops entered Adigrat near the Eritrean border as residents celebrated the deployment.
